observations: Standing cooker with a top electric hotplate and a bottom gas hob with four burners.
The oven door is open in all photos, showing the interior.
The control panel has five knobs: four black and one white.
The brand name 'CHIGO' is visible on the front panel in photo 2.
The top surface of the hotplate shows significant staining and discoloration.
The gas burners show heavy soot and residue, suggesting heavy or infrequent use.
The oven interior appears clean but lacks a clear view of the heating element or thermostat.

risks.risk: The gas burners may be blocked, leaking, or have faulty ignition.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners lit and staying lit.

risks.risk: The electric hotplate may be burnt out or have a damaged heating element.
risks.proof: A photo of the hotplate surface while powered on or a video of it heating.

risks.risk: The oven may not heat or may have a broken thermostat.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven light on and the interior heating up.

risks.risk: The control knobs may be stuck or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing all knobs being turned and the corresponding burners/hotplate responding.

proof_requests: Video of all four gas burners lit and burning.
Video of the electric hotplate powered on and heating.
Video of the oven light on and the oven heating up.
Close-up photo of the hotplate surface to check for burns or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
